title: Choose the ingestion method for each requirement
objective_text: Pick the ingestion method for a requirement from volume, frequency, data types and governance needs.
scenario: A retailer's platform team gets six ingestion requests in one week: a SaaS CRM, a stream of JSON files, an operational SQL Server database, a SQL-only team, a source with no connector, and a stream whose folder listing has become expensive.
verifies: You can pick the right component, method or trigger for each scenario, with the reason and source shown afterwards.
does_not_verify: That you can set it up in Databricks: nothing is created or run here.

validation.fail: Not all right yet: reread the lesson's notes and try again.

explanation: Each question's answer, reason and source page are shown after a pass or on request.
review_notes: Every claim was checked against its source page on 2026-11-09.
